_approach: Kick removed; the sharp offbeat closed hats and the alternating 909 ride keep the tempo alive over a soft 16th shaker. A lone clap on beat 4 of bar 2 and one open hat hint at the return. This is the stripped 're-entry' space that hard techno uses instead of long melodic breakdowns. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
